seed: Lost my umbrella

# Why I Gave My Umbrella to the Universe

I lost my umbrella today.

Some would call that careless.

I call it a bold act of weather-forward leadership.

I'll be honest, I felt vulnerable.

A little damp, a little exposed, a lot visionary.

Here's what it taught me about leadership:

☔ Protection is overrated, presence is everything.

🌧️ Rain is just the market testing your commitment.

🚀 If you never lose anything, you're not scaling.

🙏 I'm humbled to report that I am now drier on the inside than ever.

My wet socks have never been more aligned with my values.

Agree?
